commitMessage: uncommitted: fix sparse_softmax_cross_entropy_loss_with_logits forward+grad with direct loop
notes: FIXED: sparseSoftmaxCrossEntropyWithLogits was returning -5.943e148. Root cause: scatterForLoss subarray extraction had stride bug causing reads from wrong rows. Fix: replaced complex reduce+broadcast+scatterForLoss chain with direct per-example loop computing -log(softmax(logits[i])[label[i]]) for forward, and softmax-one_hot for grad. Both forward (direct op test) and gradient check (testLoss2d 187/187) now pass.
